Chanting Reminders

Sends a notification at 10:00 AM, 3:00 PM, and 8:30 PM if you haven't finished your rounds, with a dedicated chanting sound. In the installed app, these are true background notifications — they keep firing even when the app is closed, minimized, or the phone is locked, and stay on until you turn them off.

Mangal Arati Reminders

Four daily reminders — 3:30 AM, 4:00 AM, 4:30 AM, 5:00 AM — each with its own uploaded sound.

Event Reminders

Automatically notifies you at 3:30 AM on the day of every Ekadashi and observance you've added, using your phone's local timezone.

Test & Debug

Sends one notification 10 seconds from now. Press it, then put the app in the background and wait — this is the fastest way to confirm notifications actually work on this device, without waiting for a scheduled time.
